Fourth development release of 0.19.0: it fixes the upgrade from 0.18.1 failing on installs that have floor plans, and topology cards now show their whole name.

> [!CAUTION]
> **This is a development release. It is not stable and it contains bugs.** Do not run it in production or on data you can't restore. Take a backup before upgrading a test install, and expect behaviour to change before 0.19.0. If you run into a problem, please [submit a bug report](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) - every report helps get 0.19.0 right.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Upgrading from 0.18.1 with floor plans:** 0.19.0-dev3 stopped at `api.0231_floor_plan_site` with "cannot CREATE INDEX ... pending trigger events" and rolled back to 0.18.1. Upgrade straight to this release instead; no workaround is needed.

### Topology

- **Names are never cut.** Cards grow to fit the whole name and wrap a very long one onto more rows, on the Diagram (Simple, Detailed and Photo), the Hierarchy, site and location cards, provider network cards and virtual chassis frames. The layout and the SVG, PNG, PDF and draw.io exports use the same sizes, so printed maps carry full names.

### Fixed

- **Upgrades from 0.18.1** failed in `api.0231_floor_plan_site` when the install had a floor plan: the one-transaction migrate left foreign-key checks pending before the migration's index was created. The checks now run after every data step of a migration as well as between migrations.
- **The upgrade's retry** after a failed one-transaction migrate ran inside the transaction it had just failed in, so it failed the same way. It now rolls that transaction back and retries on a new connection, as a plain migrate would.
